
This is the etiquette to follow if you are editing things on this site.  Please direct all questions to [mailto:webmaster@lojban.org]].

==  Do ==

* Use the --'''discuss''' tab-- [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban ain mailing list] to talk about the contents of a page. --If you want to automatically see what people are saying in discuss tabs of pages you've created, [http://www.lojban.org/lsg2/ ubscribe to the wikidiscuss list].--
* Use whole words, spaces, and punctuation in page names.

==  Don't ==

* Use WikiChat, that is, comments '''about''' a page's content in the page itself.  --Use the discuss tab.--
* UseCamelCase.  It's ugly and doesn't work well for Lojban.

* USE ALL CAPS, FOR ANYTHING, EVER!   Especially Lojban text.
